name: Llyn Llyw
text: Llyn Llyw is a Welsh lake name that links to the story of the salmon. In early tradition the pool is tied to the fish of wisdom, the creature that brings deep knowledge in Irish and Welsh tale.

attributes.attribute: Welsh lake name tied to the salmon legend
